title: DojoLiq Ten Tangerines 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Ten Tangerines is a vibrant dedication to a single, beloved citrus fruit. Every puff delivers an explosion of juicy Tangerine flavour, capturing both the intense, sugary sweetness and the bright, zesty tang of the real fruit. It is a bold, sun-drenched profile that offers a smooth and incredibly refreshing citrus vape without any sharp bitterness. This Nicotine Salt e-liquid is mixed to an exact 45% VG / 55% PG ratio, a bespoke split chosen to maximise the specific flavour saturation and wicking speed for this recipe. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
